text: Finally have it finished and up. The compartments are .... Finally have it finished and up.  The compartments are small - so no towels in there.  Putting the bottom together was problematic with the flat screws they sent.  Ended up with problems when we tried to screw them in and they nicked some.  We bought screws that were pointed rather than the flat screws that were included and finally got it together.
